title: Focus Block Protection Rate
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar exports (`calendar:event`), email metadata (`email:metadata`), password-audit reports (`passwordmanager:audit`).
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, password-audit exports, and calendar/email feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=calendar:event category=focus
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as focus_blocks, sum(eval(status="cancelled")) as cancelled by _time
| eval kept_pct=round(100*(focus_blocks-cancelled)/focus_blocks,1)
| where focus_blocks>0 AND kept_pct<70
| sort kept_pct
description: Measures how many planned focus blocks actually survived the week instead of being cancelled or surrendered to meetings.
value: Deep work only exists if it stays defended on the calendar; this turns that aspiration into a compliance number.
implementation: Tag protected calendar time clearly; review weekly keep rate and identify which days or stakeholders eat it most often.
visualization: Weekly table of scheduled focus blocks and kept percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces how often the focus time you blocked on your calendar actually stayed protected instead of getting wiped out.
